abilities.name: Change to Chute
abilities.trigger: A Small or larger creature approaches within 20 feet of the top of the stairs

abilities.name: Reaction
abilities.text: The stair risers shift downward, forming a steep ramp while exposing lines of razor-sharp blades. All creatures on the stairs must succeed at a DC 32 Reflex save or tumble down the chute, taking 2d6 bludgeoning damage, 4d12+26 slashing damage, and landing prone in area A4.

hazard.description: The stairs collapse into a downward spiral.
hazard.disable: Thievery DC 35 (master) to decouple several mechanisms barely accessible through gaps between the shifting risers, or Perception DC 38 to note which stairs have slightly different wear patterns to know which ones are safe to step on
hazard.name: Flensing Chute

traits.name: Uncommon
traits.text: Something of uncommon rarity requires special training or comes from a particular culture or part of the world. Some character choices give access to uncommon options, and the GM can choose to allow access for anyone. Less is known about uncommon creatures than common creatures. They typically can't be summoned. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to these creature is increased by 2.

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
